species.name: Melpaca
species.desc: Don't be fooled by this Pal's fluffy appearance. A hypersonic kick from one of its long legs may send you flying to the other side of the world.

species.name: Kitsun
species.desc: Despite its appearance, Kitsun is extremely sensitive and will flee into a cave when spooked. Long ago, it was considered an ill omen if one ran away from you.

species.name: Kitsun Noct
species.desc: Despite its appearance, Kitsun Noct is extremely sensitive and will flee into a cave when spooked. It has become quite gloomy from being a shut-in for too long.

species.name: Anubis
species.desc: Once seen as a symbol of nobility, and an idol for those who shunned wealth and power. Yet over time, this Pal became a token of death.

species.name: Nyafia
species.desc: Strongly dislikes anyone catching a glimpse of its concealed eye. If you insist on trying, it'll burst into tears and ignore you for two weeks.

species.name: Incineram
species.desc: In the dark of night, this Pal snatches prey to bring back to its territory. What happens to those poor souls afterwards isn't too hard to imagine.

species.name: Incineram Noct
species.desc: It specifically targets baby Pals, taking them back to its domain. One can only imagine the profound despair of a parent whose child has been taken away.

species.name: Mau
species.desc: Its hard tail does not deteriorate even when cut off. Some believed these severed tails bring good luck, but for the innumerable Mau who were poached as a result, they were anything but.

species.name: Mau Cryst
species.desc: Its crystalline tail is beautiful, but shatters when this Pal dies. Some believe it is good luck to raise them, so Mau Cryst in captivity are treated with great care.

species.name: Caprity
species.desc: The shrub on this Pal's back produces berries as long as it is properly fed. It offers these berries to potential mates, and if the flavor is to their liking, romance blossoms.

species.name: Caprity Noct
species.desc: The berries that grow on its back change flavor according to its emotions. The harsher the environment it grows in, the sweeter the berries become. This is why most Caprity Noct raised in captivity have never known love.

species.name: Vanwyrm
species.desc: The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm are said to cross whole mountain ranges. In ages past, such flutes were used to signal an attack.

species.name: Vanwyrm Cryst
species.desc: The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm Cryst are said to cross whole mountain ranges. In ages past, such flutes were used to signal victory in battle.

species.name: Necromus
species.desc: Once one with Paladius. Its darkened form is the embodiment of negative emotions. However, a glimmer of compassion can still be seen deep within its eyes.

species.name: Dragostrophe
species.desc: A silent beast born of the abyss. Thou shall not stand before the beast. Thou shall not heed the beast.

species.name: Shadowbeak
species.desc: Born from the depths of insanity, its very existence defies reason. Having lost all genetic ties to other Pals, one wonders if it could still even be considered a Pal.

species.name: Astegon
species.desc: A savage beast born of the abyss. Thou shall not stand before the beast. Thou shall not heed the beast.

species.name: Smokie
species.desc: The black flames are merely warm to the touch, but anything left in contact with them slowly melts from the inside. Hold some cheese over them, and it becomes a true delicacy.

species.name: Smokie Cryst
species.desc: The blue flames are merely cool to the touch, but anything left in contact with them slowly freezes. Hold a milk bottle over them, and you get a frozen milkshake!

species.name: Azurobe
species.desc: This Pal's white ribbon turns black if doused with impure water. Given its usefulness in detecting poison, this Pal was once overhunted. This past has left them bitter towards humanity.

species.name: Azurobe Cryst
species.desc: This Pal’s white ribbon continuously absorbs heat from its surroundings, yet its temperature remains curiously unchanged. This strange ability once made it a target of relentless hunting, leaving it with a deep mistrust of humans to this day.

species.name: Fuack
species.desc: Using its own body water, this Pal can create waves anywhere. It body surfs when in a hurry, but the resulting speed often ends in a fatal collision.

species.name: Fuack Ignis
species.desc: With a belly built for friction, this Pal sparks flames as it body surfs. But when it gets carried away, it often ends up a rolling fireball.

species.name: Shaolong
species.desc: Its ring is reserved for a special occasion: upon meeting its destined companion, the rings are traded, a symbol of their eternal partnership.

species.name: Azurmane
species.desc: Like Univolt, it was once believed to be connected to the Thunder God. As faith in Univolt waned, Azurmane was deemed the God's true envoy. Even so, time reduced both to the same lowly status of ordinary workhorses.

species.name: Prunelia
species.desc: Intelligent and graceful in its demeanor, it was frequently employed as an attendant by the island's nobles. However, when encountered at night, its face looked so eerie that it quickly fell out of favor.

species.name: Rushoar
species.desc: Being an extremely aggressive Pal, it often picks fights before gauging its opponents' strength. Though small, its powerful charge can even send boulders flying.

species.name: Lapiron
species.desc: Listens to the earth as it runs, avoiding unstable footing with ease. However, uncooperative terrain will trick it into falling over constantly.

species.name: Needoll
species.desc: Its spikes react to its emotions. A dearly cherished Needoll is something one may instinctively want to embrace. But more often than not, it ends in a tragic accident.

species.name: Needoll Noct
species.desc: Its spikes react to its emotions. A well-loved Needoll Noct clings to its owner, but accepting that love means accepting the pain too.

species.name: Sootseer
species.desc: It was once believed that as the world approached its end, the flame would weaken. Doomsayers would repeatedly rejoice when the flame began to weaken, but in the end, it turned out to be a prank by Sootseer. At least, for now.

species.name: Penking
species.desc: Surprisingly, it is unrelated to Pengullet. However, since this Pal gets pampered as it pleases, for now, it's doing its best to strut arrogantly.

species.name: Penking Lux
species.desc: Its body changed color after gaining electricity to improve underwater hunting. As a result, it lost the affection of Pengullet— but strangely enough, it now has a loyal follower: Pengullet Lux.

species.name: Lifmunk
species.desc: Intelligent as a five to seven-year-old human child. It makes a wonderful partner, but there have been more than a few cases where they've killed their master after learning to use weapons.

species.name: Tombat
species.desc: Often appears out of the blue to flaunt its prized wings in front of other Pals. Although this appears to be an intimidation tactic, the Pal seems to derive some kind of pleasure from the display.

species.name: Katress
species.desc: With the power of shadows, it produces arcane phenomena. It prefers to eat food raw and is particularly hostile towards Wixen.

species.name: Katress Ignis
species.desc: Due to its upbringing, it no longer cares about whether its food is raw enough. This Pal stopped worrying about those details, and just prefers its food to be as spicy as possible. Not on good terms with Wixen Noct.

species.name: Felbat
species.desc: Attacking from the shadows, this Pal traps its prey within its cloak-like wings. It's probably best not to know what happens within them, or why the inside of its wings are stained red.

species.name: Chikipi
species.desc: Extremely weak and far too delicious. It is one of the weakest Pals alongside SheepBall. No matter how many are hunted, they just keep appearing.

species.name: Amione
species.desc: If one disappears, another simply shows up to take its place, and life goes on like nothing happened. For Amione, companionship is everything.

species.name: Clovee
species.desc: Some individuals once had three or more leaves on their foreheads. Regarded as symbols of good fortune, those with more leaves were heavily hunted, leading the species to evolve fewer leaves over time.

species.name: Dupin
species.desc: A copy it created might quietly replace it, leaving even the Dupin itself unsure whether it is still the original.

species.name: Tocotoco
species.desc: A frightening Pal that produces exploding eggs. It often fires these eggs from its rear end as a form of defense, but when spent, the Pal itself explodes.

species.name: Mozzarina
species.desc: Milk pours from this Pal like water from an open faucet, regardless of its gender. It's truly a mystery of life, although this mystery may be better left unsolved.

species.name: Tetroise
species.desc: Those stones on its back are not just cargo. Set them down somewhere distant and they will slowly make their way back home.

species.name: Tetroise Primo
species.desc: Even if the stones on its back were to be removed, Tetroise Primo will know where they are. No matter how far apart, it will always track them down.

species.name: Cinnamoth
species.desc: Sniffing its scales produces a feeling of unparalleled euphoria. There was some effort to further regulate this byproduct, but the Free Pal Alliance have vehemently opposed these measures, putting a stop to them.

species.name: Vixy
species.desc: The idol of Palpagos Island. If you bully a Vixy, you best be prepared to become enemies with the whole world.

species.name: Fuddler
species.desc: Its large claws boast of diamond-like hardness. However, sharpening these claws consumes most of its energy, leading it to sometimes spending entire days doing nothing else.

species.name: Souffline
species.desc: Its fluff can be used to hide away unpleasant memories. Once carried off by the wind, you can bid farewell to the darkness they carried.

species.name: Xenovader
species.desc: Can send information and convert it into energy by forgetting it. Regularly seems to be sending information to someone. - Respond. Target located. Proceed to immediate destruction.

species.name: Cawgnito
species.desc: Long ago it freely soared the skies. After losing a contest with Galeclaw, it abandoned the skies, and now lives a secretive life in the dark of night.

species.name: Majex
species.desc: It appears to be striking a heroic pose, but the reality is that it's simply bracing itself against the weight of its tail and hair to avoid toppling over.

species.name: Xenolord
species.desc: -Destination reached. Priority: Locate entity |Supersonic Dragon| -Note: Conquest deadline exceeded by <://Error_Code:126DC> years. -Update: No conquest traces found. Naturalization confirmed. Commence elimination protocol. -Staff Memo: Refrain from forgetting or consuming critical data!

species.name: Menasting
species.desc: Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow. This Pal crams still-living prey into its hollow body, where it absorbs them. Hellish screams of pain can often be heard coming from inside this Pal.

species.name: Menasting Terra
species.desc: Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow. It stuffs earth and minerals into its outer shell, achieving overwhelming mass. Those who are struck by it can only let out hellish groans.

species.name: Eikthyrdeer
species.desc: The one who possesses the most impressive antlers becomes the leader of the herd. If their antlers are broken, they become depressed and leave the herd never to be seen again.

species.name: Eikthyrdeer Terra
species.desc: The individual with the hardest horns becomes the leader. Once the horns are lost, so too is its leadership status. It leaves the herd amidst farewell glances and quietly returns to the earth.

species.name: Aegidron
species.desc: In ancient times, when means of communication were limited, the light within Aegidron's wings was used to send simple flash signals.

species.name: Daedream
species.desc: It puts those it is interested in to sleep and shows them an endless stream of happy dreams. Those who fall under its spell are never to wake until death takes them.

species.name: Digtoise
species.desc: A Digtoise possessing the strongest shell and the only drill capable of piercing it, ponders the contradictions of the world in the popular children's tale, |Digtoise's Fable|.

species.name: Galeclaw
species.desc: A Pal that can easily take flight even while grasping a human. It is, however, prone to letting go when tired, which has led to the sudden demise of more than a few souls.

species.name: Sparkit
species.desc: During the dry season, this Pal is always on the verge of blowing a fuse. Sparks can fly with even the slightest provocation, even amongst allies.

species.name: Boltmane
species.desc: The more it moves, the more it heats up and the hair tips increasingly glow brighter. At its peak, it becomes so dazzling that you risk blindness if you stare at it directly.

species.name: Slowatt
species.desc: Doing as they please, sleeping when they wish, and eating whatever they like. Surely, Slowatt must be toiling in secret to maintain such a luxury. ...Or so the old islanders told themselves, just to get by.

species.name: Grizzbolt
species.desc: With a friendly smile and a hardy physique, it is docile towards one it recognizes as a partner. For reasons unexplained, its personality undergoes a drastic change when wielding a minigun.

species.name: Puffolt
species.desc: Its fluffy fur absorbs tremendous amounts of water when soaked. Shaking it dry releases a powerful electrical discharge, making bath time together a serious gamble.

species.name: Snock
species.desc: Tossing an Snock into the bath for a shock spa is considered a traditional health practice. That is to say, the results may be rather shocking.

species.name: Snock Lux
species.desc: Tossing a heated Snock Lux into the bath for a scorching spa was once a fad of the distant past. Owing to a recent revival, it is now quite literally a hot trend.

species.name: Elphidran
species.desc: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it is sometimes unable to discern good from evil, often allowing wrongdoers to take advantage of it.

species.name: Elphidran Aqua
species.desc: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it harbors no ill will in any of its actions and is indifferent even after killing someone.

species.name: Dazemu
species.desc: Take one step forward and forget your doubts. Take two steps forward and forget your worries. Take three steps forward and forget your fears. Face any enemy.

species.name: Fenglope
species.desc: In ages past, its beautiful visage was a common sight in paintings. As time passed, its beautiful pelt and antlers were often seen in works of art.

species.name: Fenglope Lux
species.desc: In ages past, it was believed that drawing a picture of Fenglope Lux would result in being struck down by lightning. As time passes, artworks depicting Fenglope Lux became revered as charms to ward off lightning, making them a common presence.

species.name: Pyrin
species.desc: Its entire body has evolved into a highly efficient radiator, gifting it with astounding stamina. If someone rides it, this Pal takes caution not to burn them.

species.name: Pyrin Noct
species.desc: It burns mysterious dark matter as energy and expels the remaining particles from its body. If someone rides it, they should take care so as not to gallop down the path of darkness.

species.name: Rooby
species.desc: Wild Rooby surprisingly never get sick. Eating one piece of charcoal a day, made by burning a branch, is the secret to its eternal health.

species.name: Arsox
species.desc: In ancient times, carnivorous Pals pursued them relentlessly. The absurd fury in the cries of Arsox transformed into a raging inferno, which has been passed on to this day.

species.name: Dinossom
species.desc: A Pal who once angered cannot be pacified. It rages on and on like an inferno. The phrase |step on a Dinossom's tail| has come to mean enraging someone.

species.name: Dinossom Lux
species.desc: Though struck by lightning, it lives on. The phrase |struck by a Dinossom Lux's bolt| has come to mean narrowly escaping death.

species.name: Petallia
species.desc: A Pal that transforms into a massive plant when at the end of its life. Once every ten years, a beautiful flower blooms and a new Petallia is born.

species.name: Petallia Ignis
species.desc: A Pal that burns away into a pile of ash upon the end of its life. The surrounding soil becomes incredibly fertile, allowing an abundance of vegetation to thrive for the following decade.

species.name: Dandilord
species.desc: Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil. What it protects, and for what purpose, Dandilord does not care. After all, the World Tree knows everything. Only the mist it wields can reveal the truth.

species.name: Flopie
species.desc: It prefers places that have an abundance of vegetation, but hay fever has apparently become a problem for Flopie as of late.

species.name: Muffly
species.desc: Its soft facial fluff softens any hit, but it cannot groom itself well nor scratch its itches, leaving it in a constant state of mild frustration.

species.name: Celaray
species.desc: Riding the wind, this Pal travels where it pleases. Should it find a partner along the way, the encounter will mark its journey's end.

species.name: Celaray Lux
species.desc: Its flashy patterns help it attract a partner. But after a long history of electrocution incidents involving Celaray Lux, yellow-and-black stripes are now seen across the island as a sign of danger.

species.name: Flaracle
species.desc: It focuses its mind and reads the future through flames. Should it glimpse an inconvenient destiny, it relentlessly rerolls the prophecy until it gets a favorable result. That is why the future of Flaracle is always exceptionally bright!

species.name: Wixen
species.desc: With the power of light, it produces arcane phenomena. It prefers to eat food well-done and is particularly hostile towards Katress.

species.name: Wixen Noct
species.desc: Due to its upbringing, it no longer cares about whether its food is cooked enough. This Pal stopped worrying about those details, and just prefers its food to be as sweet as possible. Not on good terms with Katress Ignis.

species.name: Teafant
species.desc: Large amounts of water pour from what is thought to be its nose, though some say that it is, in fact, just snot. This has sparked a fierce debate among Pal scholars.

species.name: Direhowl
species.desc: Long ago Direhowl would hunt alongside humans but over the years this bond faded.

species.name: Ghangler
species.desc: With its shining lure, it illuminates the darkness. The wandering Pals drawn in by the light stand no chance of escape once spotted by GhostAnglerFish. No matter how far, it will keep guiding them until they get home safe and sound.

species.name: Ghangler Ignis
species.desc: Its blazing lure doubles as a grill for roasting prey. Drawn in by the delicious aroma, Pals have no hope of escape once Ghangler Ignis sets its sights on them. In the end, they’re treated to a hearty meal—until everyone’s full.

species.name: Maraith
species.desc: It relishes the peculiar scent living things give off when they are near death. If a Maraith has taken a liking to you, it is safe to assume that is why.

species.name: Wispaw
species.desc: The ghostly hands behind it embody the souls of all humans who have raised its kind. Lately, they seem to have reached a unanimous consensus to dote on Wispaw.

species.name: Eidrolon
species.desc: A new Pal that was only recently discovered. Calm and entirely docile, it spends its time as it pleases. It is no longer bound by anything.

species.name: Eidrolon Ignis
species.desc: A new Pal that was only recently discovered. It trusts nothing and no one, and its tempermental nature leads to it constantly venting its rage at the nearest target.

species.name: Nitemary
species.desc: What it carries is its own soul. When it falls for someone, it forcibly extracts their soul and merges it with its own, yearning to become one.

species.name: Nitemary Botan
species.desc: What it carries is its own soul. When it falls for someone, it flings its soul at them to merge it with theirs, yearning to become one.

species.name: Gildane
species.desc: During the golden age of alchemy on the island, its ever-glowing golden fur was highly prized as a catalyst for transmuting gold. In time, a remarkable revelation was made: the same golden hue could be achieved simply by processing its mane.

species.name: Gorirat
species.desc: It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. The meaning of each rhythm differs by troop, but the distinction between them is still largely unknown.

species.name: Gorirat Terra
species.desc: It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. Stronger than Gorirat, if every Gorirat Terra hit the ground at the same time, the island would sink in 1 second.

species.name: Dualith
species.desc: One entity, two minds. When their wills clash, it's impossible to tell where the armor will wander until they reconcile.

species.name: Dualith Noct
species.desc: One entity, two minds. They rarely agree and bicker constantly, but once battle begins, mind and body instantly unite as one!

species.name: Mammorest
species.desc: The vegetation on its back varies between individuals. There is a long history of appreciating this veritable garden of a Pal, and there are even Mammorest pruning specialists.

species.name: Mammorest Cryst
species.desc: The vegetation on its back varies between individuals. There was a time when seeds of presumed extinct plants were found still frozen on the back of a Mammorest Cryst.

species.name: Elgrove
species.desc: The leaf on its horn cannot be removed, no matter how hard it is pulled. When the leaf falls on its own, Elgrove accepts its time has come.

species.name: Elgrove Cryst
species.desc: Its frozen horn stays solid through its life. When water begins to drip from this ice, Elgrove Cryst feels the chill of its own life slipping away.

species.name: Mossanda
species.desc: A Pal so powerful it's hard to believe. In one experiment, this Pal tore through 3,000 sheets of paper at once! It's only by some miracle that this Pal isn't a meat-eater.

species.name: Mossanda Lux
species.desc: A Pal whose power is truly shocking. By altering the electrical currents in its body, this Pal's been able to overload its own strength. When it comes to sheer power, this Pal may be top of the list.

species.name: Verdash
species.desc: Land that Verdash has run across becomes extremely fertile, with thick vegetation growing soon after. It will not run anywhere that herbicide has been used.

species.name: Splatterina
species.desc: It has an uncontrollable urge to tear its prey apart. Each individual has their own meticulous order for dismemberment. If caught by Splatterina, pray that your head is taken first.

species.name: Yakumo
species.desc: It has a strong sense of justice and despises evil. In the past they were faithful and loving companions to the islanders. Nowadays, Yakumos are hostile to humans wherever they spot them.

species.name: Helzephyr
species.desc: It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell. Those who dies from Helzephyr's lightning are sure to have their soul sent to the underworld.

species.name: Helzephyr Lux
species.desc: It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell. While considered a subspecies of Helzephyr, there's a theory that suggests Helzephyr Lux, struck by lightning from hell, will transform into Helzephyr.

species.name: Nitewing
species.desc: It carries newborn Pals to its nest and raises them as a surrogate parent. Once the baby Pal has fattened up, it hunts them.

species.name: Jolthog
species.desc: It releases the electricity stored in its body when under attack. The voltage it generates exceeds 10 million volts, making it more lethal than any conventional heavy firearms when thrown.

species.name: Jolthog Cryst
species.desc: It releases the cold air stored in its body when under attack. The frigid blast it radiates is cold enough to freeze the surrounding air and easily pierces through any attacker's body.

species.name: Warsect
species.desc: The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is extremely strong and heat resistant. Even a napalm blast would hardly leave a scratch.

species.name: Warsect Terra
species.desc: The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is extremely strong and heat resistant. It doesn't flinch even if a Mammorest steps on it.

species.name: Hoodle
species.desc: When it sleeps, it deflates. When it sleeps, it's no longer there. A sleeping Hoodle cannot exist; Therefore, Hoodle never sleeps.

species.name: Faleris
species.desc: When it finds its prey it unleashes a whirlwind of flames, burning the entire area to ash. Faleris breath is known for its pleasing scent.

species.name: Faleris Aqua
species.desc: When it finds its prey, it unleashes a mighty torrent, sweeping the entire area. More often than not, the prey gets swept away in the chaos, leaving one to wonder whether this truly counts as hunting.

species.name: Munchill
species.desc: The inside of its mouth stays pleasantly cold, making it a natural fridge when closed. Its saliva contains enzymes that prevent food from rotting. Thus, it can serve as a food locker for humans— whether it is sanitary or not is another matter entirely.

species.name: Reindrix
species.desc: Its transparent cerulean antlers glow with the cold of absolute zero. Any who touch them with their bare hands are instantly frozen and smashed to pieces.

species.name: Foxcicle
species.desc: On nights when the aurora is visible, it looks up towards the sky and begins to howl a beautiful song. This does, however, leave it vulnerable to attacks from enemies.

species.name: Frostallion
species.desc: Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Winter Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal winter.

species.name: Frostallion Noct
species.desc: Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Night Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal darkness.

species.name: Whalaska
species.desc: When it sleeps, Pals often mistake it for a drifting piece of ice and rest on it. Although gentle and unwilling to push them away when awake, it feels quietly stressed by the intrusion on its personal space.

species.name: Whalaska Ignis
species.desc: Determined never to be mistaken for drift ice again, it turned bright red through sheer will. Unfortunately, some Pals can’t see red. So despite its efforts, its personal space continues to be invaded.

species.name: Polapup
species.desc: Among Polapups, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect. Sometimes, a too-forceful leap sends one tumbling from the sky— a common sight during territorial season. Forecast: clear skies with a chance of flying Polapups.

species.name: Polapup Terra
species.desc: Among Polapup Terras, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect. Sometimes, a too-forceful leap leaves one buried in the snow— a common sight during particularly competitive seasons. Traffic forecast: heavy Polapup Terra congestion.

species.name: Icelyn
species.desc: Though its body melts in the heat, it just can’t resist sunbathing. Though its body melts in the warmth, it likes hot springs too much. If it's going to melt anyway, it hopes it’ll be in a steaming outdoor bath under a clear blue sky.

species.name: Jelliette
species.desc: A Pal that closely resembles Jellroy. It’s very social, so when plans overlap, it asks its good friend Jellroy to go in its place. As thanks, one date.

species.name: Jellroy
species.desc: A Pal that closely resembles Jelliette. It sometimes appears as a substitute when Jelliette is unavailable. Its acting is so flawless that no one ever notices the switch.

species.name: Jetragon
species.desc: Watches over Palpagos Island from high above. When calamity returns to the land, the earth will split open, and the skies will burn. It is destined to strike down the calamity in a flash of total destruction.

species.name: Renjishi
species.desc: At a glance, its movements appear exaggerated and full of openings. Strangely, however, any opponents become overwhelmed, and become unable to look away, as if transfixed.

species.name: Kelpsea
species.desc: Its personality changes depending on the quality of the water it was born into. Kelpsea born into polluted waters are generally ill-tempered and quickly become delinquents.

species.name: Kelpsea Ignis
species.desc: Its personality changes depending on the temperature of the water it was born into. Kelpsea born in warm waters generally have a passionate, motivated personality.

species.name: Croajiro
species.desc: Those who disgrace the honor of the herd are forced to take their own life. By piercing their inflated vocal sac with a tree branch, they are blown away into the atmosphere and return to the afterlife.

species.name: Croajiro Noct
species.desc: The Croajiro who have forsaken their honor gather and form splinter groups. They will use any underhanded means to take down their chosen prey. If you encounter a pack of Croajiro Noct in the dead of the night, it's your life that's on the line.

species.name: Kingpaca
species.desc: Melpaca serve this Pal. Contests between Kingpaca offer up their vassals as a wager. Those seen alone are losers of such contests.

species.name: Kingpaca Cryst
species.desc: With a heart of ice, this Pal is terrible at expressing its emotions. A solitary individual is pitiable, seen as too clumsy in the eyes of a Melpaca.

species.name: Blazamut
species.desc: Legends say it was born during a volcanic eruption. A strange group even claims that this continent is laid upon the back of a giant Blazamut.

species.name: Blazamut Ryu
species.desc: Long ago, it emerged from the depths of the earth. With relentless, raging flames showing no mercy, it burned the entire island until nothing remained. It was known as the Eternal Flame.

species.name: Solmora
species.desc: Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, it could reach speeds beyond 88 mph.

species.name: Solmora Lux
species.desc: Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, it could generate over 1.21 gigawatts of power.

species.name: Panthalus
species.desc: The last of its species, keeping its sacred duty close to heart. Even should its long obligation ever be fulfilled, its cries for its mother would only be answered by a solitary echo.

species.name: Univolt
species.desc: It used to be considered an emissary of the Thunder God, and thus was not hunted by people. However, after witnesses observed one die from a lightning strike, its reverence faded, and it quite literally fell into the role of a workhorse.

species.name: Univolt Cryst
species.desc: It used to be considered an emissary of the Winter God, and thus was not hunted by people. However, after witnesses observed one lose its footing on the ice, its reverence faded, and it quite literally slid into the role of a workhorse.

species.name: Foxparks
species.desc: It is unskilled at controlling fire from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the flames it breathes unintentionally. Foxparks sneezes are one of the leading causes of forest fires.

species.name: Foxparks Cryst
species.desc: It is unskilled at controlling cold air from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the frost it breathes unintentionally. When Foxparks Cryst catches a cold, its nasal discharge freezes, making it difficult to breathe and causing it to panic.

species.name: Loomen
species.desc: Its lantern glows with an eerie light that lays bare the truth of the world. If that light strikes you as blinding, then you most likely have something to hide.

species.name: Flambelle
species.desc: When it starts crying, this Pal produces magma in place of tears. The magma that pours out is absorbed back into its body, causing it to get hotter and hotter. The more it cries, the stronger it becomes.

species.name: Dumud
species.desc: When too relaxed, its reaction time drastically declines. Even if it were sliced from head to tail, it probably wouldn't even realize that it should be dead until the next morning.

species.name: Dumud Gild
species.desc: Its body reflects light with astounding clarity. Even more shocking, its reflexes are somehow even slower than Dumud.

species.name: Relaxaurus
species.desc: Contrary to its blasé appearance, it's quite ferocious. It perceives everything in its sight as prey and will stop at nothing to devour it.

species.name: Relaxaurus Lux
species.desc: One day, Relaxaurus had an idea. Maybe it was about time for a change. Just then, an electric shock raced through its body!

species.name: Herbil
species.desc: When in doubt, punch it till it works—that’s Herbil's approach to fixing things. With strength perfectly tuned for humans, sometimes just one punch is enough to restart a stopped heart.

species.name: Lullu
species.desc: In early spring, pollen floats on the wind throughout the island. Flopie's hay fever is Lullu's fault.

species.name: Hartalis
species.desc: The silence is unsettling, yet strangely soothing. No one else remains. All have been delivered. O King of Salvation, carry me too into eternal stillness. -The ancient text cuts off here.

species.name: Lyleen
species.desc: A docile Pal full of love. It watches over small Pals who have lost their parents. It uses a full-power SolarBeam to discipline naughty Pals.

species.name: Lyleen Noct
species.desc: An elegant Pal full of grace. It admonishes any who are disrespectful with a painful slap. Some Pals actively seek out this punishment.

species.name: Bristla
species.desc: This prickly Pal's thorns are highly poisonous. It is friendly with Cinnamoth and only smiles while a Cinnamoth is drinking its nectar.

species.name: Leezpunk
species.desc: A Pal that always takes great care to maintain a stylish stance. Always on the hunt for the coolest poses, if given a mirror it will spend all day posing in front of it.

species.name: Leezpunk Ignis
species.desc: A Pal that has an unusual obsession with their standing posture. Always in search of the hottest pose, this Pal's owner is constantly presented with fervent stances.

species.name: Valentail
species.desc: In older paintings, it is depicted as much smaller than it is today. For reasons unknown, various parts of its body have begun to elongate rapidly in recent years, and it is predicted to reach nearly ten times its current size within the next century.

species.name: Ophydia
species.desc: Waters where Ophydias dwell are often filled with flowers that mimic its form. Many attempts have been made to directly propagate these blooms, but they inevitably wither the moment human hands interfere.

species.name: Blazehowl
species.desc: While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating well-done meat. This is due to its blistering claws, which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn't realize its prey gets burned to a crisp.

species.name: Blazehowl Noct
species.desc: While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating tainted meat. This is due to its dark claws, which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn't realize its prey gets cursed.

species.name: Mimog
species.desc: There was once a tradition of handing out an award to the person who met their end in the most foolish way. The first award was given for |being unaware of Mimog, opening the chest, and being bitten to death.|

species.name: Tanzee
species.desc: Long ago, this Pal used long objects like tree branches as weapons. After coming into contact with humans, however, it found something slightly more effective: guns.

species.name: Tanzee Ignis
species.desc: Its palms have evolved to handle burning objects without getting scorched. When its gun runs out of ammo, it may grab the heated barrel with its bare hands and use it to club its foes.

species.name: Solenne
species.desc: Joy and misery come in equal measure for Solenne. Those who choose to take care of one must be prepared for what that entails.

species.name: Wistella
species.desc: At the end of its life, a new star appears somewhere in the skies, glowing with the weight of its memories.

species.name: Selyne
species.desc: The object floating behind, resembling the moon, is said to gradually become more circular with each passing generation. No one knows what will happen when the moon is full.

species.name: Swee
species.desc: Crawling along the ground, it eats microscopic organic matter. After a while, it discharges any substances that provide no nutrition. By using it as a mop for cleaning, everyone wins!

species.name: Sweepa
species.desc: While hibernating, a large number of Swee hide within its voluminous body hair. The most ever recorded is 101.

species.name: Silvance
species.desc: Since ancient times, it has remained within the World Tree, continuing its vigil. What it protects, and for what purpose, Silvance does not know. After all, the World Tree will tell it everything. The spores it commands surely know who the enemy is.

species.name: Gildra
species.desc: The golden, bandage-like organs covering its body are highly elastic. However, they are prone to tearing under extremely dry conditions, so daily moisture checks are absolutely essential.

species.name: Shroomer
species.desc: Inhaling large amounts of its spores will put you into a trance. Sometimes, if Shroomer appears motionless, it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom, but rather because it's high off its own spores.

species.name: Shroomer Noct
species.desc: The abundance of spores released by this Pal blocks out sunlight. Sometimes, if Shroomer Noct appears motionless, it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom, but rather because its own spores don't let it see anything.

species.name: Mycora
species.desc: It views humans as nothing more than convenient parasitic hosts. The reason Mycora has taken this form is to deceive humans into lowering their guard, allowing its spores to spread more efficiently.

species.name: Lunaris
species.desc: It can control those who carelessly stare into its eyes. Those seen with a Lunaris are in its mind, simply under its control.

species.name: Omascul
species.desc: The mask it wears is not its face, they say. It seems in front, but it's not there, no way. From shadows deep, it watches night and day. Glance away, and closer it will stray.

species.name: Grintale
species.desc: Grintale's eyes light up the moment anyone enters its territory. This is no figure of speech—its eyes literally light up.

species.name: Depresso
species.desc: It has few friends because of the perpetually grouchy look on its face, but it is in fact kindhearted. Some have seen it feeding Vixy who have strayed from their pack.

species.name: Killamari
species.desc: It wraps itself around an enemy's head, sucking out their insides. Pal mummies are occasionally found, but these are in fact Killamari victims.

species.name: Killamari Primo
species.desc: It sinks its fangs into the enemy’s neck, draining every last drop of blood. When two Killamari Primos latch onto each other, they become locked in a relentless struggle—each trying to suck the other dry until one withers away.

species.name: Starryon
species.desc: It takes great pride in its flowing, gorgeous mane. If it finds a split end, it becomes so mortified it can't focus on running properly. Because static electricity makes its hair frizzy, it avoids Azurmane at all costs.

species.name: Starryon Primo
species.desc: It takes great pride in its glowing, gorgeous mane. If it gets even slightly dirty, it becomes so mortified it can't focus on running properly. Because skin oils ruin its coat, it wants to avoid being touched too much, even by its favorite Pal Tamer.

species.name: Nox
species.desc: If you find Nox hair in your bedding, you should leave it where it lays and leave immediately. Picking it up is a one-way-ticket to a never ending night.

species.name: Bellanoir
species.desc: Without existing, she quietly gazed upon the world. One day, she was seized with a longing to be seen. With unbridled lust for vengeance against reality, thus was born the Eclipsed Siren.

species.name: Bellanoir Libero
species.desc: With her desires set loose, she was soon overwhelmed. She longed for a self to gaze upon herself. And the sisters who gazed, resenting reality, were driven into the abyss and, at last, closed their eyes.

species.name: Gloopie
species.desc: Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal. Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like hickeys. One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some truly awkward misunderstandings.

species.name: Gloopie Primo
species.desc: Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal. Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like bite marks. One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some truly unnecessary concern.

species.name: Bakemi
species.desc: It lives entirely for the thrill of the scare, but is utterly un-frightening. As most cannot help but indulge it with feigned surprise for its cuteness, Bakemi now leaves a trail of smiles in its wake.

species.name: Leafan
species.desc: To hone the martial art passed down through a single bloodline: Daily training is the only way! Being distracted by romance? Unthinkable! Daily discipline is the only way! The time has come! Shoot my shot! Instant rejection, that’s all there is! The techniques of love were never passed down... Lingering regret, that’s all there is!

species.name: Pengullet
species.desc: The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, but sadly, its desire to fly has remained as strong as ever. Even now, it tries to fly again in any way it can.

species.name: Pengullet Lux
species.desc: The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, and it can no longer fly. Yet its longing for the sky has turned to jealousy— so it harnessed electricity to strike down those who still soar.

species.name: Cattiva
species.desc: At a glance it appears full of confidence, but it is in fact weak and cowardly. Being toyed with by a Cattiva is in many ways the greatest of disgraces.

species.name: Lovander
species.desc: Seeking a night of love, it is always chasing someone around. At first it only showed interest in other Pals, but in recent years even humans have become the target of its debauchery.

species.name: Ribbuny
species.desc: A Pal that's never without a bright smile. Occasionally, its tentacles get tied up in knots by Cattiva's pranks. During those moments, its expression turns demonic.

species.name: Ribbuny Botan
species.desc: Always wears a cheerful smile. Sometimes, thanks to Cattiva's pranks, they end up tangled in tentacles and have to fight their way out! Even in tough situations, they keep smiling cheerfully.

species.name: Gumoss
species.desc: A strange Pal with a body resembling tree sap. It gradually loses strength if it has nothing to cover its body with, eventually rotting away.

species.name: Braloha
species.desc: Its breath carries a miraculous, pollen-like substance that pollinates any plant it touches. For plant-based Pals, being near it can be a bit… complicated.

species.name: Neptilius
species.desc: After the sealing of the calamity, a champion from Feybreak emerged. It stares out to sea, awaiting one it deems worthy. For such encounters are no coincidence—they are fate.

species.name: Tarantriss
species.desc: Extremely sticky and clingy. The more it's resisted, the more tenacious it becomes. Such is its |personality.|

species.name: Elizabee
species.desc: A chosen queen to rule over Beegardes. There is a never ending stream of servants willing to work themselves to death for the pleasure of serving their queen.

species.name: Dazzi
species.desc: Often kind to lonely Pals. However, the moment a Pal mistakes this for actual friendship, it seizes the opportunity to blast them with a thunderbolt.

species.name: Dazzi Noct
species.desc: Often kind to lonely Pals, it plots to lure them into dropping their guard before striking them down. Yet, unable to find the right moment, it ends up making friends with them instead.

species.name: Ragnahawk
species.desc: Some think it is a related species to Beakon, but there is in fact no connection. It mainly eats rocks, and after many long years its beak and head have hardened to accommodate this diet.

species.name: Tropicaw
species.desc: While some say that it flails around to mimic flowers swaying in the wind and avoid predators, others argue that a crimson flower thrashing violently at high speeds is simply so unsettling that nothing dares approach it.

species.name: Robinquill
species.desc: A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the forests. It may prove to be a key for understanding what Pals are and how they diverged from humans in the distant past.

species.name: Robinquill Terra
species.desc: A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the rocky areas. When Robinquill Terra bones are found in ruins, there are always human bones found nearby as well.

species.name: Pierdon
species.desc: It smashes its body against harder rocks to maintain its preferred shape. Those with noticeable dents are best left alone, much like people with a botched haircut.

species.name: Pierdon Cryst
species.desc: It basks in the sun, rotating just enough to melt its ice into its preferred shape. Lopsided ones should be left alone, much like a person who was a little too bold with their sideburns.

species.name: Bushi
species.desc: Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If someone other than a Bushi wields this blade, the soul within torments them until they are driven mad.

species.name: Bushi Noct
species.desc: Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If the Bushi who inherits it has a weak heart, the voices of the dead will drive it mad. The madness turns it into Bushi Noct that endlessly wanders.

species.name: Paladius
species.desc: Once one with Necromus. Its gleaming form is free of all negative emotions. However, a glimmer of hatred can still be seen deep within its eyes.

species.name: Broncherry
species.desc: Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma after finding a partner, which is called the |Fragrance of First Love.|

species.name: Broncherry Aqua
species.desc: Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma before finding a partner, which is called the |Perfume of Purity.|

species.name: Pupperai
species.desc: Pupperai territorial disputes begin with a staredown and end in a single, quick strike. Training them to |stay| is risky business, as the |go| command triggers that same attack instinct.

species.name: Prixter
species.desc: It has about 5,000 types of venom. Some of them are deadly enough to cause instant death, but none are present in a high enough concentration to have any effect.

species.name: Prixter Lux
species.desc: It pierces foes with its tail to deliver an electric jolt directly into their bodies. However, the current it generates is extremely weak, so a simple punch would do far more damage.

species.name: Sekhmet
species.desc: Once a fierce creature feared as a symbol of death. When Anubis claimed that mantle, wealthy elites looking for a replacement beguiled the species with wine. Before long, Sekhmet became a symbol of high nobility.

species.name: Surfent
species.desc: Its hydrodynamic form is well suited for activities on water. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.

species.name: Surfent Terra
species.desc: Its aerodynamic form is well suited for activities on sand. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.

species.name: Gobfin
species.desc: Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking requires much energy, it gradually became smaller and is now a small and puny Pal.

species.name: Gobfin Ignis
species.desc: Long ago, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, as food became scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking burns many calories, it astonishingly awakened its power to control fire!

species.name: Dogen
species.desc: Striving for a state of selflessness, it meditates endlessly. After confronting its worldly desires, it eats a meal and reflects. It ate too much today.

species.name: Quivern
species.desc: Sleeping while cuddling a Quivern is said to be a heavenly experience, but there are some who have been crushed and sent to heaven by ones that toss and turn in their sleep.

species.name: Quivern Botan
species.desc: When you hug Quivern Botan, if it smells like sunshine and meadows, tomorrow will be sunny. If it smells damp, tomorrow will be wet and miserable.

species.name: Lapure
species.desc: It uses the long, flowing fur on its hands to attract attention, always taking the utmost care to keep them maintained. Highly sensitive to dirt and meticulously clean, kicking up dust nearby will invite a very disgusted glare.

species.name: Kikit
species.desc: A decade ago, Kikit soccer was popular. However, it quickly fell out of favor due to fierce opposition from the Free Pal Alliance. Nevertheless, the Kikit's themselves didn't mind because it helped shed their old carapace.

species.name: Snugloo
species.desc: “To look at a Snugloo's eyes” is an expression which means to seek the unseen essence of things. Ironically, no researcher has ever confirmed whether Snugloos have eyes in the first place.

species.name: Venusa
species.desc: Whenever it's confused, it resorts to consulting with the snakes on its head. However, since they're all ultimately the same being, it comes to understand that nothing is understood.

species.name: Frostplume
species.desc: So precise is its sense of time that it awakens at the exact same hour every morning. According to Palpagos lore, a day was divided into 24 parts because when Frostplume spreads its tail feathers wide, it reveals a pattern with 24 distinct spaces.

species.name: Bastigor
species.desc: The sight of anything round gives it an uncontrollable urge to punch it. For SnowTigerBeastMan the toughest challenge, after simply living, is making a snowman.

species.name: Beegarde
species.desc: A servant that pledges loyalty to Elizabee. Any that cause harm to the queen are immediately expelled from the hive. It will gladly give its life to protect its queen.

species.name: Finsider
species.desc: It looks like something is peeking out from inside a costume, but even if you reach inside, there’s nothing there. In fact, you can keep reaching deeper and deeper. Perhaps the universe itself lies within.

species.name: Finsider Ignis
species.desc: Even if you reach into its mouth, there’s nothing inside—it just keeps going. Thinking it might be an interdimensional space, one researcher tried climbing in like a sleeping bag. But when the gag reflex kicked in, they realized... it’s definitely part of the creature’s body.

species.name: Bulldosu
species.desc: In the old islands, Bulldosu sumo was widely enjoyed. At the highest levels, even a charging Rushoar would be sent flying instead.

species.name: Suzaku
species.desc: It was once believed to usher in the dry season. Whenever there was a drought the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to bring about a plentiful harvest in the next year.

species.name: Suzaku Aqua
species.desc: It was once believed to usher in the rainy season. Whenever there was a flood the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to avert disaster in the coming year.

species.name: Woolipop
species.desc: Its entire body is 18,000 times sweeter than sugar. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent will find themselves overwhelmed by sweetness and even pass out should they take a bite of this Pal.

species.name: Woolipop Terra
species.desc: Its fur emits a sweet smell, but its meat is disgustingly bitter. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent into taking a bite will find themselves overwhelmed by the foul taste and pass out.

species.name: Skutlass
species.desc: A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body and uses its bones to slice through enemies, at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long. While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans.

species.name: Skutlass Ignis
species.desc: A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body and uses its bones to slice through enemies, at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long. While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans.

species.name: Turtacle
species.desc: To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. Unfortunately, it's utterly defenseless underneath. Even a little tickle could knock it out cold.

species.name: Turtacle Terra
species.desc: To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. With most of its senses concentrated in its limbs and shell, it can’t even tell if someone quietly touches its core.

species.name: Roujay
species.desc: A thief by nature, it snatches items when no one is looking. No reason to be concerned when caught in the act. Once it swiftly steals your eyes, you won’t be seeing anything anyway.

species.name: Beakon
species.desc: Some think it is a related species to Ragnahawk, but there is in fact no connection. Using its sharp beak, it descends on its prey in a quick motion that resembles a bolt of lightning.

species.name: Beakon Cryst
species.desc: Perfectly adapted to colder environments, it hardly feels the cold despite its slender form. Its diving plunge carries tremendous force, as if a giant icicle were dropping straight from the sky.

species.name: Rayhound
species.desc: At full speed, it could be mistaken for a bolt of lightning. When two Rayhounds collide, a thunderous roar echoes through the air.

species.name: Rayhound Cryst
species.desc: Sprinting across the tundra at full speed kicks up a blinding blizzard, leading to constant Rayhound Cryst collisions due to zero visibility.

species.name: Orserk
species.desc: It sends electricity into its foes' wounds, roasting them from the inside out. Fights between Orserk end in the blink of an eye.

species.name: Dynamoff
species.desc: With so little to eat at high altitudes, it will occasionally even feast on its enemies' brains. It is thought that groups seeking a more dependable food source descended to lower skies, ultimately diverging into Beakon.

species.name: Palumba
species.desc: Disrupts enemies’ rhythm with a signature dance. In turf battles, the first to fall in sync with the other’s rhythm loses. Courtship, boredom, battle—it all comes down to dance! Now then, what could a dance aimed at a human possibly mean?

species.name: Jormuntide
species.desc: Legend says the Jormuntide was once a wise man who, after being wrongly convicted and cast into a whirlpool, returned as this Pal to annihilate the kingdom.

species.name: Jormuntide Ignis
species.desc: Legend says the Jormuntide Ignis was once a warrior who, after being wrongly convicted and cast into a volcano, returned as this Pal to annihilate the kingdom.

species.name: Carnibora
species.desc: Prone to eating indiscriminately, the mouth atop its head frequently breaks out in agonizing ulcers, causing it to use the mouth on its face instead. However, its behavior doesn't change, which leads to both mouths suffering the same ulcers.

species.name: Vaelet
species.desc: The castle was filled with the king's favorite flowers. A great battle ensued, and flames approached the castle. Amidst the chaos, the spirit of a flower appeared. - From the fairy tale, |The King's Flower.|

species.name: Reptyro
species.desc: Magma-like blood runs throughout its body. If a large amount of water is thrown on it, the water rapidly heats, causing an immense vapor explosion.

species.name: Reptyro Cryst
species.desc: Ice cold blood runs throughout its body. If heated rapidly, its blood evaporates, causing an immense vapor explosion.

species.name: Moldron
species.desc: In a healthy individual, the lava on its back flows smoothly. However, a poor lifestyle will gradually worsen its circulation, eventually causing a lava clog that results in a sudden, massive explosion.

species.name: Moldron Cryst
species.desc: In a healthy individual, the substance flowing along its back maintains a stable temperature. However, if its heartbeat quickens, the temperature destabilizes, eventually triggering vaporization or crystallization that results in a sudden, abrupt death from shock.

species.name: Chillet
species.desc: It can curl up its body and roll around at extremely high speeds. Long ago, people would tie bags of milk to domesticated Chillet as they grazed to produce butter using this spinning force.

species.name: Chillet Ignis
species.desc: It can curl up its body and roll around so fast that sparks fly. Sparks also fly when it feels excited. If you stroke it too much, this pal will get fired up, literally!

species.name: Loupmoon
species.desc: The horns on its head grow under the moonlight. It doesn't hate the sun, but its horns itch when sunlight hits them.

species.name: Loupmoon Cryst
species.desc: The horns on its head are made of a mysterious ice that never melts. Shaved ice made by breaking off a horn is truly exquisite, but both the one who tries it and Loupmoon Cryst end up with a headache.

species.name: Xenogard
species.desc: Consumes information and turns it into energy. Regularly seems to be sending information to someone. - Hello? What was the message you just sent? I devoured it before checking.

species.name: Celesdir
species.desc: Ancient texts refer to it as the |Beast of Salvation.| The light emitted by Celesdir purifies everything, literally causing things to vanish from existence without leaving a trace.

species.name: Celesdir Noct
species.desc: Where blinding radiance shines, dark shadows are born. It scatters an all-enveloping darkness to reclaim the chaos that ought to be. Balance is what the world requires.

species.name: Sibelyx
species.desc: A Pal that likes the rain, and will often bask in rain showers until the weather clears up. On rainy days, Foxparks can often be found taking shelter beneath it.

species.name: Sibelyx Primo
species.desc: A Pal that loves gazing into the void, and will often remain completely still. It frequently becomes a gathering spot for smaller Pals.

species.name: Silvegis
species.desc: The metallic components around its neck possess magnetic properties. If the leg pieces get too close, they cling to it. When metal debris builds up on its neck, it grudgingly begins cleaning, and grows frustrated when they won't come off easily.

species.name: Cryolinx
species.desc: It can easily climb steep mountains with its hard claws. However, its short legs make it difficult to descend, often leaving it stranded in high places.

species.name: Cryolinx Terra
species.desc: It can easily carry many items with its large hands. However, its short legs slow its pace, often leaving it overtaken by nightfall.

species.name: Hangyu
species.desc: Its gigantic arms can rip apart even iron. As a particularly cruel form of execution, serious criminals would be strung up in a public square, and a Windchimes would tear the skin right from their bones.

species.name: Hangyu Cryst
species.desc: Its gigantic arms can tear through blocks of ice. There were times when great sinners were tied in the town square and had their hair torn out by Windchimes_Ice as a brutal form of public humiliation.

species.name: Knocklem
species.desc: Can be disassembled into 215 parts. It is capable of being reassembled and functioning again even if the parts are scattered. Mixing parts from different individuals will trigger a malfunction due to mistaken identity.

species.name: Knocklem Ignis
species.desc: Upon disassembly, it is capable of being reassembled and functioning again. Mixing parts from different individuals will trigger a fatal cognitive error that causes its systems to overheat.

species.name: Hoocrates
species.desc: Often lost in thought, it sometimes finds it difficult to sleep. |I think, therefore I am.|

species.name: Cremis
species.desc: Compared to SheepBall, it has finer wool and a temperament more suited for domestication. However, it has historically always been kept as a pet. Cuteness is considered a virtue.

species.name: Astralym
species.desc: A shadow of its former self, this mysterious Pal descended upon the Palpagos long ago. Bringing ruin and calamity, it was sealed away for millennia until it was ultimately defeated by a certain Pal Tamer

species.name: Eye of Cthulhu
species.desc: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.

species.name: Demon Eye
species.desc: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.

species.name: Green Slime
species.desc: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.

species.name: Blue Slime
species.desc: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.

species.name: Illuminant Slime
species.desc: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.

species.name: Purple Slime
species.desc: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.

species.name: Rainbow Slime
species.desc: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.

species.name: Red Slime
species.desc: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.

species.name: Enchanted Sword
species.desc: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.

species.name: Cave Bat
species.desc: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.

species.name: Illuminant Bat
species.desc: [Tides of Terraria] A monster from another world, now tameable in this realm.

species.name: Wumpo
species.desc: Researchers once tried to shave off its hair to reveal its true form. In the end, only hair was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.

species.name: Wumpo Botan
species.desc: Researchers once tried to cut the grass off its body to reveal its true form. In the end, only grass was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.
